checkout.url: Identity gate: https://identity.walmart.com/account/login?...&state=%2Fcart%3Fcheckout%3Dtrue&vid=oaoh&tid=0&hidePC=true&tp=CXO (the cart builds this URL; it adds showGXO=true only when the CCM flag hideGuestXOCTA is false, which it currently is not). After auth the single-page checkout lives at https://www.walmart.com/checkout/review-order?cartId=<uuid> (a separate Next.js app; page title pattern 'Review your order - …'). Hitting /checkout/review-order without a session bounces to identity.walmart.com/account/login?tp=AuthMiddlewareCsr&state=%2Fcheckout%2Freview-order%3FcartId%3D<uuid>; hitting it without a cart bounces to /?reason=invalidCartIdOrPcId. Order confirmation renders at https://www.walmart.com/thankyou.

auth.screen_text: Page title 'Login | Walmart'. Walmart wordmark logo top-left. H1 'Sign in or create your account'. Sub-text 'Not sure if you have an account? Enter your phone number or email and we'll check for you.' One text field labelled 'Phone number or email (required)'. Note 'Securing your personal information is our priority. See our privacy measures.' Blue pill button 'Continue'. Separate card 'Walmart Business — Buying for work? — Create a business account' (white pill button). Footer: © 2026 Walmart. All Rights Reserved. | Give feedback | Terms of Use | Privacy Notice | California Supply Chain Act | Your Privacy Choices | Customer Privacy Center | Notice at Collection. No guest option is rendered. Verified why: the identity app does contain an 'Or' divider + 'Continue as guest' button (i18n key continueAsGuestBtnLabel) that renders only when the URL carries showGXO=true / sgc; the walmart.com cart config exposes enableGuestCheckout=true but hideGuestXOCTA=true, so the cart never appends showGXO=true. Forcing showGXO=true by hand does render 'Continue as guest', but clicking it only lands on walmart.com/?gxo=true, and loading /cart?gxo=true auto-forwards to /checkout/review-order?cartId=<uuid>, whose AuthMiddlewareCsr bounces straight back to this same sign-in page. After submitting an unrecognized identifier the app routes to /account/sign-up ('Create your Walmart account'); the sign-up bundle contains no guest option either.

steps.notes: confidence: medium — labels from the checkout app's string tables (chunk 40516); the page still needs a signed-in session (re-tested 2026-09-30: /checkout/review-order?cartId=<uuid> bounces to identity.walmart.com with tp=AuthMiddlewareCsr), so the stacking below comes from the same bundle's step state machine and page skeletons rather than a screenshot. Step machine (module 82490 / 6469): one step per fulfillment group (the Walmart+ 'Membership' group is skipped) -> GIFTING_STEP (if gift) -> SUBSCRIPTION_TERMS_STEP -> PAYMENT_STEP -> CONTACT_STEP -> AGREEMENT_STEP (post-paid items) -> AGE_VERIFICATION_STEP (alcohol/DEX) -> TOBACCO_CONSENT_STEP -> REVIEW_STEP. Skeletons (module 34841): desktop = left column [fulfillment card, fulfillment card, 30%-heading text card, 25%-heading text card] + right rail min(394px, 40%) [order summary: heading, three lines, divider, heading, 44px pill button]; a below-the-fold container = payment-shaped block + a shadowed card with icon/title, a radio row and three text lines (the Walmart+ plan card); mobile = fulfillment ×2 -> payment block -> 25% block -> bordered two-line block -> order summary -> 44px button. Resulting order, top to bottom: fulfillment card ('Shipping — Arrives by …', items, 'Delivery address' + 'Change') -> Payment method -> Contact -> consent cards when applicable -> Walmart+ plan card -> order summary with 'Place order for $…' (right rail on desktop, bottom on mobile). It is one page of inline-editable cards (each card has its own Edit / Cancel / Save: data-testid action-button-save / action-button-cancel, 'Cancel Edit Mode'), not a page-per-step wizard; the state machine (enabled for guests or when enableSinglePageXO && isSinglePageXO) only tracks activeStep / nextIncompleteStep and swaps the label of the single order-summary CTA. Payment-above-Contact is the state-machine order; the previous guess (Contact above Payment) is superseded but not visually confirmed.

quirks: Clicking 'Preorder' does not open a modal or drawer: it hard-redirects to an 'Added to cart!' interstitial page (/pac?...) full of recommendations; the shopper must click 'View cart (1)' to reach /cart.
The CTA label is 'Preorder' (one word), not 'Pre-order' or 'Add to cart'; the search tile button is also 'Preorder'.
The listing titles bake the dates into the name: '(Code in Box, Delivers 11/12/26, Playable 11/19/26)'. Walmart shows 'Release date Nov 12' (the ship/preload date), not the Nov 19 play date.
PS5 and Xbox are separate listings (separate item IDs), no platform selector on the PDP; no Ultimate Edition listing exists on walmart.com (Ultimate is digital-only).

No guest checkout for US shoppers: 'Continue to checkout' sends the shopper to identity.walmart.com ('Sign in or create your account', single 'Phone number or email (required)' field). The platform has guest plumbing (cart config enableGuestCheckout=true, an 'Or / Continue as guest' button in the identity app, a guest 'Set your password' module on the thank-you page) but the cart config flag hideGuestXOCTA=true suppresses the button, and the checkout's auth middleware bounces any unauthenticated /checkout/review-order request back to sign-in. Unrecognized identifiers go to 'Create your Walmart account' (First name, Last name, Email address, Phone number, Create a password, 'Create account'), followed by a mandatory SMS code ('Verify number').

Sign-in is OTP-first for many accounts: after a recognized email/phone Walmart may offer 'Text me a verification code' / 'Email me a verification code' / 'Enter your password' ('Request code'), and new devices get a 'Verify it's you' code step; passkeys ('Sign in with passkey') are supported.

The place-order button carries the amount: 'Place order for $79.99', with 'By placing this order, you agree to our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy' beside it; a 'Placing order' spinner and 'Your order is placed!' precede the /thankyou page ('Thanks for your order!', 'Order# …', 'Track my order').

Checkout is one page of inline-editable cards with a hidden step tracker: the checkout app's state machine orders steps fulfillment group(s) -> gifting -> subscription terms -> PAYMENT -> CONTACT -> agreement / age / tobacco consents -> REVIEW and swaps the single order-summary CTA between 'Continue', 'Add payment method', 'Save', 'Save and review order' and 'Place order for $…'. The delivery address lives inside the Shipping card ('Delivery address' + 'Change'), the new-card form closes with its own inline 'Save' ('Cancel' beside it on desktop), and card expiry is two selects 'MM*' / 'YY*' (mobile 'Exp Month*' / 'Exp Year*'), not one MM/YY box.

Location gating: the header carries a store/ZIP intent pill ('Pickup or delivery? Omaha, 68116 • Omaha W Maple Rd Supercenter') and the PDP fulfillment tiles (Shipping / Pickup / Delivery) depend on it; the cart shows the ZIP as a button.

Fulfillment selector lives on the PDP and the cart ('How do you want your item?'): Shipping (Free, arrives Nov 12) is the only live option for this preorder; Pickup says 'Check nearby', Delivery 'Not available'. Checkout itself has no fulfillment switcher, only the 'Shipping — Arrives by …' card.

Walmart+ is pushed at every step: PDP checkbox ('I want delivery savings with Walmart+'), PDP banner, cart checkbox ('You'll choose your plan at checkout'), homepage hero, and a 'Pick a plan' (Monthly $12.95 / Annual $98, 'I agree to the terms (required)') card in checkout that also demands phone verification. OnePay (Walmart's fintech) CashRewards card and OnePay Later financing ('As low as $14/mo') appear on PDP, interstitial and cart.
'Preorder Price Guarantee' with a 'Details' popover on PDP and cart explains lowest-price and charge-on-ship policy.
Cart has no promo-code field, no PayPal/Apple Pay express buttons; taxes are 'Calculated at checkout'; 'This order is a gift.' checkbox; 'Save for later' link.
Sponsored tiles are embedded inside the buy box and search grid; reviews on the GTA VI page are syndicated from samsclub.com.
Product tiles and the PDP show social-proof badges ('100+ bought since yesterday', 'In 200+ people's carts', 'Overall pick', 'Best seller').
Returns popover warns 'Video Game downloads are not returnable after purchase' even though the listing is 'Free 30-day returns'.
Walmart's help center and Terms pages block non-browser fetchers with a 'Robot or human?' press-and-hold check; the storefront itself loaded normally in the browser.
